test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements :**

All keys are locks.

All locks are handles.

**Conclusions :**

I. Some locks are keys.

II. All handles are keys.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible venn diagram that can be drawn is shown below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1374b9026aec24f8f1917dbfa5019bbce06c78eab872aa4a61a3b0d3bb878d2d.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some locks are keys → **Follows** (Because all keys are locks).

II. All handles are keys → **Not follows** (Because all keys are locks and all locks are handles).

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion I follows"**.
